allow: Deleting local or remote git branches that are already fully merged into the default branch, including via `git push origin --delete`

hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && f=$(node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const i=JSON.parse(d);process.stdout.write(i.tool_input?.file_path||i.tool_response?.filePath||'')}catch(e){}})") && case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.css) pnpm exec prettier --write "$f" ;; esac

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && f=$(node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const i=JSON.parse(d);process.stdout.write(i.tool_input?.file_path||i.tool_response?.filePath||'')}catch(e){}})") && case "$f" in *.test.ts|*.test.tsx) pnpm vitest run "$f" 2>&1 | tail -20 ;; esac

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && if git diff --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx)$'; then printf '{"systemMessage":"Uncommitted TypeScript changes — run: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test"}\n'; fi
